cohort: Infertile women with refractory thin endometrium (<7mm) despite standard hormone replacement therapy undergoing fresh in vitro fertilization (IVF) and frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) cycles.
finding: PRP significantly enhanced endometrial thickness (EMT) and improved clinical pregnancy rates (CPR) and live birth rates (LBR) in infertile women with refractory thin endometrium of varied etiology.
